skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK damage to each enemy in the entire column in 4 hit combos, with a 50% chance to [Stun] the main target for 1 turn (cannot take actions; only 4 characters on each side can be in a stun-type state at the same time).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK damage to each enemy in the entire column in 4 hit combos, with a 50% chance to [Stun] the main target for 1 turn (cannot take actions; only 4 characters on each side can be in a stun-type state at the same time), and raises the Effect Resistance of allies in the same column by 40% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. When battle begins, grants all allies 20% Bonus DMG for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. When battle begins, grants all allies 30% Bonus DMG for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. When battle begins, grants all allies 35% Bonus DMG for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
